judul_en: Does iced water make you fat?

adegan.vo: [curious] Minum air es... | bikin gendut? | {p0}Mitos... | atau {p1}fakta?
adegan.vo_en: [curious] Drinking iced water... | makes you fat? | {p0}Myth... | or {p1}fact?

param_en.judul: Does iced water make you fat?

adegan.vo: [excited] Jawabannya... | {jawab}MITOS! | [excited] Air es itu | {besar}nol kalori! | [whispers] Tapi ada pelaku sebenarnya... | {teaser}di akhir video.
adegan.vo_en: [excited] The answer... | {jawab}MYTH! | [excited] Iced water has | {besar}zero calories! | [whispers] But there's a real culprit... | {teaser}at the end of the video.

adegan.vo: [curious] Malah sebaliknya: | {l0}air es suhunya sekitar empat derajat. | {l1}Tubuh harus menghangatkannya | sampai tiga puluh tujuh derajat. | [surprised] {l2}Itu butuh energi: | kira-kira enam belas kalori | per setengah liter! | [laughs] Kecil sih, | tapi jelas nggak bikin gendut.
adegan.vo_en: [curious] In fact, it's the opposite: | {l0}iced water is about <4°C=four degrees>. | {l1}Your body has to warm it | up to <37°C=thirty-seven degrees>. | [surprised] {l2}That takes energy: | about <16 calories=sixteen calories> | per half liter! | [laughs] Tiny, sure, | but it clearly won't make you fat.

adegan.vo: [serious] Jadi, siapa pelakunya? | {k}GULA! | [dramatically] {i0}Air es tawar: nol kalori. | {i1}Es teh manis dua sendok gula: | sekitar seratus kalori! | Padahal batas gula sehari | {angka}cuma empat sendok makan.
adegan.vo_en: [serious] So, who's the culprit? | {k}SUGAR! | [dramatically] {i0}Plain iced water: zero calories. | {i1}Sweet iced tea with two spoons of sugar: | about <100 calories=a hundred calories>! | And the daily sugar limit | {angka}is just <4 tablespoons=four tablespoons>.

adegan.vo: [playful] Jadi, minum air es? | Aman, asal tawar! | Kirim ke temanmu | yang masih takut minum es!
adegan.vo_en: [playful] So, iced water? | Safe, as long as it's plain! | Send this to a friend | who's still scared of ice!

fakta.klaim: Air putih tawar (termasuk air es) tidak mengandung kalori.
fakta.klaim_en: Plain water, iced or not, has no calories.

fakta.klaim: Batas konsumsi gula 50 g (4 sendok makan) per orang per hari.
fakta.klaim_en: Sugar limit: 50 g (4 tablespoons) per person per day.

fakta.klaim: Es teh dengan 2 sendok makan gula (±25 g) berisi ±100 kkal dari gula.
fakta.klaim_en: Iced tea with 2 tablespoons of sugar (~25 g) carries ~100 kcal from sugar.
fakta.catatan: 1 sdm = 12,5 g (50 g = 4 sdm, Permenkes 30/2013); 25 g x 3,87 kkal/g = 97 kkal.

fakta.klaim: Menghangatkan 500 ml air dari 4 °C ke 37 °C butuh ±16 kkal.
fakta.klaim_en: Warming 500 ml of water from 4 °C to 37 °C takes about 16 kcal.
fakta.catatan: 0,5 kg x 33 °C x 1 kkal/(kg·°C) = 16,5 kkal; energi riil yang dikeluarkan tubuh bisa berbeda.
